conventions.base: Same format as cases_witness_v1.json, over bundle seed-witness-v1.1 (inbox_v3).
conventions.grammar_spec: 'entries' lists published entry IDs (absent = all 179). 'clones' keep the source's recipe, ground category, meaning and, for det.a / det.an, its next_nouns list. 'rules', 'roots', 'max_tokens' default to the published values.
conventions.article_rule: A det.a or det.an lexical edge anchors only if the immediately following token is in the inventory's next_nouns list for that entry. An unanchored article contributes no edge, no node and no budget use.
conventions.expected: tokens, construction_status, decision, diagnostic {code[, token, index]}, readings, min_cost, ranked_readings, witnesses in rank order (cost, object_wide_uses, key, reading).
conventions.edge_count: Packed bottom-up chart over all spans; node = (start, end, ground category); lexical edge = (start, end, entry ID); binary edge = (rule ID, left node, right node). Truncated iff edge_count > max_edges.
conventions.depends_on: Conventions the published texts leave open; a mismatch on such a case may be a difference of convention rather than a defect.
